title: Classes in TypeScript
overview: Classes in TypeScript are blueprints for creating objects. They support object-oriented programming concepts like properties, methods, inheritance, and access modifiers.

example.title: Class Example

title: Class Properties and Methods
overview: Classes can contain properties to store data and methods to define behaviors. TypeScript allows defining types for both.

title: Access Modifiers
overview: Access modifiers control where class members can be accessed. TypeScript provides public, private, and protected modifiers.

example.title: Access Modifier Example

title: Inheritance in TypeScript
overview: Inheritance allows one class to reuse properties and methods from another class using the extends keyword.

title: Classes in React Native
overview: Although functional components are common today, TypeScript classes help understand object-oriented concepts and are useful when working with existing class-based code.

example.title: Class Usage
example.content:
Classes are useful for:
• Data models
• Services
• Utility classes
• Object-oriented logic

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how classes work in TypeScript, including properties, methods, access modifiers, inheritance, and their usage in application development.
